admin_error: The video editor could not start. Reload the page; if it keeps happening, try again in a moment.
admin_prep_gone: This preparation no longer exists or has expired (they are kept for 7 days). Ask your assistant for a new one, or simply set up the video below.
admin_intro: Make a short video that announces your next stream. Adjust it, watch the preview, then click "Generate the video": the file is downloaded, ready to post as an Instagram story.
admin_open_tab: Open the editor in a tab
ui_no_access: This editor opens from the site administration.
ui_no_access_hint: Open the "Announcement story" page in the administration (signed in as an administrator): the editor shows up there by itself.
ui_prep_note: Your assistant prepared this video. Check the preview, change anything you like, then click "Generate the video".
ui_prep_expired: The requested preparation no longer exists or has expired. You can set up the video yourself.
ui_prep_stream_gone: The stream picked by your assistant is no longer in your calendar: the next stream is used instead.
ui_help_intro: Pick the stream, what the video shows and its style. The preview moves live. Nothing is kept on the site: the file is only downloaded.
ui_stream_manual: Another stream: I type it myself
ui_streams_slow: Your calendar is not answering right now. You can type the stream by hand, or reload the page in a moment.
ui_no_agenda: No upcoming stream was found. To see them here, install a calendar ("Online calendar" or "Hand-written streams", from the catalog) and write your streams in it. Meanwhile, type the stream below.
ui_cover_no_key: Game covers are not shown: the site owner can set up access to covers in Settings, External services. The video works fine without them.
ui_m_time_hint: Without a time, the video only announces the day.
ui_manual_time: The time is not valid: pick it from the list, or leave the field empty.
ui_el_game: Game and cover (when it is known)
ui_no_stream_info: No stream is selected: the title, day, countdown and game cannot be shown.
ui_text_help: Up to 140 characters, up to 3 lines.
ui_channel_label: Name shown next to the logo
ui_channel_help: Leave empty to use the name of your site.
ui_lang_label: Language of the words written in the video
ui_style_neon_hint: Glowing text that flickers and glitches, on a dark background.
ui_style_poster_hint: The cover and the title slide in, like a movie poster.
ui_style_countdown_hint: Big numbers roll toward the time of the stream.
ui_style_minimal_hint: Plain background, the text appears letter by letter.
ui_format_help_vertical: 1080 × 1920. The top and bottom of the screen are hidden by Instagram: everything important stays in the middle.
ui_format_help_passeport: 1080 × 1350. Small safety margins all around; everything important stays in the center, also visible in the profile grid.
ui_duration_help: From 5 to 15 seconds. 15 seconds is the length of a story.
ui_members_help: Tick the ones who appear in this video (6 at most).
ui_members_max: You picked the maximum ({n} guest streamers): untick one to pick another.
ui_adhoc_label: Add someone for this video only
ui_adhoc_help: Type a Twitch name. It is not saved in your list.
ui_saved_help: The people you announce often. They are kept for the next videos.
ui_c_image_help: Paste the address of the Twitch profile picture (right-click the picture, "Copy image address"). Without a picture, the video shows initials.
ui_member_removed: Guest streamer removed from the list.
ui_raid_import_help: Adds the partners of the Twitch raid module to your list, with their profile picture. Nothing is removed or changed for the ones already there.
ui_import_none: No partner to take for now.
ui_models_help: Keep your settings (style, format, length, elements, sentence, guest streamers) under a name to find them again in one click.
ui_model_exists: A model called "{name}" already exists: confirm below to replace it with the current settings.
ui_model_replaced: Model "{name}" replaced by the current settings.
ui_model_removed: Model "{name}" deleted. The other models did not change.
ui_safe_help: To check the preview only: the hatched zones are hidden or cropped by Instagram. They are never drawn in the video.
ui_reduced: Your device asks to reduce animations: the preview is stopped. Press "Play" to see it move. The video itself is always animated.
ui_empty: There is nothing to show: pick a stream or tick at least one element.
ui_silent_note: The video has no sound, which suits Instagram very well.
ui_progress: Making the video: {pct}%. Keep this tab open.
ui_done: Ready: "{name}" ({size} MB) was downloaded. Just post it as a story.
ui_webm_notice: Instagram prefers MP4: try Chrome or a recent Safari to get an MP4 file.
ui_recorder_notice: Your browser recorded the video in real time, which is why it took a while.
ui_err_unsupported: Your browser cannot make videos. Try Chrome or a recent Safari, on a computer or a phone.
ui_err_encoder: The video could not be made. Try again with a shorter length, or with Chrome or a recent Safari.
ui_err_auth: Access to the editor has expired. Reload the administration page.
ui_err_network: The site is not answering right now. Try again in a moment.
ui_err_invalid: This name is not valid: a Twitch name has 4 to 25 characters (letters, digits or _).
ui_err_not_channel: This link is not a Twitch channel: type the person's name.
ui_err_dup: This name is already in your list.
ui_err_full: Your list is full: remove someone before adding another.
ui_err_missing: This item no longer exists. Reload the page.
ui_err_exists: A model already has this name.
ui_err_image: This address is not a Twitch profile picture. Paste the image address, or leave the field empty.
ui_err_none: No partner to take for now.
ui_err_generic: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.
